summary: Short re-verification of the XFF/per-IP rate-limit fix from iteration_9. Spun up two fresh uvicorn servers (ports 8141 and 8142) against isolated data dirs and asserted the three required behaviours. All checks PASS and no code changes were made.

verifications.name: Server A (--no-proxy-headers): XFF cannot reset per-IP cerere bucket
verifications.steps: POST /api/public/cerere (nume=A, prenume=B, privacy_ack=1) 22x with X-Forwarded-For 10.0.0.1..10.0.0.22, plus 1 extra with 9.9.9.9.
verifications.result: First 20 = 200; 21st = 429 Retry-After=3600; 22nd = 429 Retry-After=3600; extra XFF 9.9.9.9 = 429 Retry-After=3600. PASS.

verifications.name: Server A sync-key throttle per IP ignores XFF
verifications.steps: GET /api/sync/ping with bad X-Sync-Key, rotating X-Forwarded-For 10.0.1.1..10.0.1.6 (sync key previously issued via scripts/issue_sync_key.py --source cimitir).

verifications.name: Server B (--proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips 127.0.0.1): per-XFF buckets
verifications.steps: 21x POST /api/public/cerere with XFF=10.0.0.1, then one with XFF=10.0.0.2.

verifications.name: desktop/start_local.portal_command flags
verifications.result: Default output contains --no-proxy-headers; with CIMITIR_BEHIND_PROXY=1 and FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS=10.1.1.1, output contains --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips 10.1.1.1. PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: portal_ratelimit.client_ip now relies entirely on uvicorn's resolved request.client.host; this is the correct boundary and matches the documented operational contract in the module docstring.
sync_api._auth keys its throttle on 'sync:' + portal_ratelimit.client_ip, so trusting XFF without --proxy-headers would also allow bucket evasion here; verified it does not in A.
seed_data_creation: Issued a sync key via scripts/issue_sync_key.py into /tmp/y1 (deleted after test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: XFF/per-IP rate-limit regression fully verified. Servers started on ports 8141/8142 against /tmp/y1 and /tmp/y2; all temp files/data dirs cleaned, servers killed. No code modifications were made this run.
